title: tbh a perfect saturday (don’t worry I slept most of sunday) 🤪 #ashsee...
transcript: I just got back from a theater trip to the London I probably should take a little break but I'm not doing that instead I planned a chaotic Saturday starting with bagels and one of my favorite events the survivor beachdrop I love competition reality and survivor is my absolute favorite this event was to launch the new season which starts on Wednesday you could play challenges they had meet and greats I’m met the queen herself sandra And they had a tribal council activation I had to do it it was just so much fun and I cannot wait for the new season afterwards Jeremy and I visited the Giant Pigeon and headed up the Highline to Signature Theatre we're going to the matinee of Grangeville which you didn't know much about except that Paul Sparks was in it and I loved this play it's a two person play about two very different brothers who are navigating the eminent death of their mother It’s heartbreaking and funny and emotional and I did cry at the end it just got extended until march 23 afterwards we hop on the train downtown and stopped at tacombi cause I had to try their new ramen this is my perfect collab I'm going to be eating it all winter and then the main event we’re walking over to life and trust I know literally nothing about it except that it's like vaguely the story of Faust with Ben with JT with Jeremy It’s gonna be very fun hopefully I've been wanting to do life & trust since it was announced but it was completely out of my budget until they did a two for one deal so I was so excited to finally do it I was told it was sleep no more-esq which is very accurate when you're in the experience your phone is locked away and you're also wearing like a full face mask JT what do you most excited about? I'm most excited to be seeing another immersive show I love immersive theater I've never been to a show like this cause I didn't get to see sleep no more so I'm very excited to like experience the five floors and just kind of meander and also be kind of confused and yeah it is sometimes confusing Cause there’s like 25 different storylines and you're completely on your own in terms of where you go and who you follow the choreography is by the kuperman brothers it's absolutely stunning I'm really glad I did it and honestly I wanna go again but this time know what I'm looking for exactly
